description: Get contracts between the company (as a healthcare provider) and Poland's National Health Fund (NFZ) — value of NFZ contracts in the latest year and every year since 2008, types of care (hospital, outpatient, dental, rehabilitation, pharmacy etc.) with NFZ regional branch, and the largest contracts. Amounts are annual contract values in PLN. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.
